children: SharonAI announced a five-year strategic agreement with Rafay Systems to standardize orchestration across its AI Factory environments.
Five-year agreement with Rafay Systems to use Rafay as a centralized orchestration and operations layer.
Platform will standardize provisioning, governance and monitoring across locations, tenants and workloads.
Agreement moves deployments from individual clusters to a consistent operating framework for global expansion.
Architecture is designed to support orchestration of up to 150,000 GPUs over the five-year term.
Expected benefits: improved compute utilization, faster service delivery, consistent governance and secure multi-tenancy.
